categories.name: 前沿论文
categories.commentary: 这批量集中在Agent的记忆、验证与多模态落地，以及生成模型的可控性与可解释性。

articles.title: One Figure, Every Canvas: Editable Flowchart Relayout via Agentic Pipeline
articles.zh: 一图适配所有画布：基于Agent流水线的可编辑流程图重排版
articles.summary: 如果你做流程图工具或文档排版，这套Agent流水线能让同一张图自动适配不同画布尺寸，还保持可编辑
articles.author: Shih-Chen Tseng, Chih-Hsuan Chen 等
articles.body: Pipeline figures in ML papers must be repurposed across many canvases, including paper columns, 16:9 slides, portrait posters, 1:1 social teasers, 9:16 phone previews. Each format imposes a different aspect ratio on the same computational graph, where any silently broken connection misrepresents the method. We formulate aspect-ratio-adaptive flowchart relayout as a distinct task: given a raster flowchart and a target ratio, produce a structurally faithful, hallucination-free, editable layout. Existing methods fail characteristically: image-to-image models stretch blocks and reject extreme ratios, text-to-image agentic systems hallucinate content, and parse-then-render systems mis-route edges. We propose an agentic pipeline factored into Parse, Style, and Layout stages, each pairing a main agent with a critic that combines deterministic constraint checks with VLM visual feedback so connectivity is explicitly checked and prevented from being silently broken. Outputs are draw.io-editable mxGraph XML. On a curated benchmark of 100 flowcharts at five aspect ratios, evaluated by Gemini 3.1 Pro and validated against human judgments, our method reaches 68.6% Content Fidelity versus 11.2-41.4% for prior work. Project page: https://onefigureeverycanvas.vercel.app/
articles.bodyZh: 机器学习（ML）论文里的流程管线图（pipeline figures），经常得被重新改成各种画布上的版本，比如论文分栏、16:9 幻灯片、竖版海报、1:1 社交平台预热图、9:16 手机预览图。每种格式都会给同一张计算图（computational graph）套上不同的宽高比（aspect ratio），而只要有一条连接线悄悄断了，别人就会把方法理解错。我们把“按宽高比自适应重排流程图”定义成一个独立任务：输入一张位图流程图（raster flowchart）和目标比例，输出结构忠实、不瞎编、还能继续编辑的布局。现有方法各有各的翻车法：图生图（image-to-image）模型会把方块拉变形，还处理不了极端比例；文生图（text-to-image）的智能体系统会凭空编内容；先解析再渲染的系统会把连线接错。我们提出一个智能体流水线（agentic pipeline），拆成解析（Parse）、样式（Style）和布局（Layout）三个阶段；每个阶段都配一个主智能体和一个评审器（critic），把确定性约束检查（deterministic constraint checks）和视觉语言模型（VLM）的视觉反馈结合起来，这样连接关系会被显式检查，不会悄无声息地断掉。输出是能用 draw.io 编辑的 mxGraph XML。在一个精心整理的基准测试（benchmark）上，100 张流程图、5 种宽高比，用 Gemini 3.1 Pro 来评估，并用人类判断做校验，我们的方法内容保真度（Content Fidelity）达到 68.6%，而之前的工作只有 11.2%–41.4%。项目页面：https://onefigureeverycanvas.vercel.app/

articles.title: Base Models Can Reason By Taking a Cue From Training Data
articles.zh: 基座模型也能推理——从训练数据中找线索
articles.summary: 如果你以为推理能力必须靠RL后训练才有，这篇说基座模型给点训练数据里的"提示"就能激活推理
articles.author: Sophie L. Wang, Amil Dravid 等
articles.body: In this paper, we study how training data creates associations between the tokens at the start of a base model's response and the reasoning behavior that follows. First, we demonstrate that fixing particular starting token cues makes a base model's performance competitive with that of its reinforcement learning (RL)-trained counterparts on math and coding. For instance, the cue ".\n\nOkay" raises Olmo-3-7B's MATH-500 pass@1 accuracy from 42% to 78%, while "Alright," raises Qwen3-14B's from 72% to 87%. Second, RL makes these cues more likely, while fixing them recovers much of its performance gain over the base model. Third, we trace the reasoning effects of token cues to the training data. We perform causal data interventions to turn an arbitrary word, such as "chicken", into an effective reasoning cue, or remove an existing cue's effect. A similar edit makes the prompt instruction "Think duck duck goose" as effective as "Think step by step" at eliciting reasoning. We also find that the hidden state representations induced by different cues correlate with different document types from the training set. Finally, we extend our study of token cues with a case study in language model safety, finding that different cues elicit distinct refusal and compliance behaviors that correspond to different types of training data.
articles.bodyZh: 这篇论文里，我们研究的是：训练数据到底怎么把基础模型（base model）回答开头的那些词元（token），和后面跟着的推理行为绑到一块儿。第一步，我们证明，只要把回答开头的某些提示词元（token cue）固定住，基础模型在数学和编程上的表现，就能跟经过强化学习（RL）训练的那类模型打得有来有回。比如，提示 ".\n\nOkay" 能把 Olmo-3-7B 在 MATH-500 上的 pass@1 准确率从 42% 拉到 78%；而 "Alright," 能把 Qwen3-14B 的从 72% 提到 87%。第二步，RL 会让这些提示更容易出现，而如果你把它们固定住，就能把 RL 相比基础模型多出来的那部分性能，找回来一大半。第三步，我们顺着词元提示对推理的影响，一路追到了训练数据。我们做了因果数据干预（causal data interventions）：既能把一个随便的词，比如 "chicken"，变成特别有效的推理提示，也能把一个现成提示的效果给消掉。类似的改动，还能让提示指令 "Think duck duck goose" 在激发推理这件事上，跟 "Think step by step" 一样好使。我们还发现，不同提示引出来的隐藏状态（hidden state）表示，会跟训练集里不同类型的文档相关。最后，我们把这个词元提示研究延伸到了语言模型安全上，做了个案例研究，结果发现：不同提示会引发不一样的拒绝（refusal）和配合（compliance）行为，而这些行为又对应着不同类型的训练数据。

articles.title: BiasFlow: Geometric Monitoring and Backbone Regularization for Spurious Feature Reliance
articles.zh: BiasFlow：针对伪特征依赖的几何监控与骨干网络正则化
articles.summary: 如果你在头疼模型学到数据里的虚假相关性、换分布就崩，这套几何监控+正则化能提前发现并压制
articles.author: Haojin Deng, Zhiping Lin 等
articles.body: Worst-group accuracy (WGA) evaluates a trained predictor but does not characterize how its frozen backbone behaves when a new head is learned. We introduce BiasFlow, a hook-based toolkit for monitoring class-attribute centroid alignment (IBMI), within-class centroid separation (W-IBMI), and feature-projection sensitivity. IBMI is confounded by class-attribute correlation and is not a measure of causal feature reliance. We pair these diagnostics with BiasFlow Regularization (BFR), a supervised, composable class-conditional centroid-alignment penalty. W-IBMI verifies the quantity BFR optimizes; it is scale dependent and does not independently establish attribute removal. Across the reported small-scale benchmarks, adding BFR improves or preserves mean WGA, with gains up to +26.0 pp on UrbanCars. The principal independent stress test freezes CelebA-Std backbones and trains fresh heads on biased data: BFR+GroupDRO improves WGA from 40.7% to 64.1%, while Male probe accuracy decreases from 92.5% to 72.2%. Attribute information remains recoverable, and cross-task results are mixed. A controlled synthetic-watermark ImageNet experiment additionally improves watermark-shift accuracy by +23.0 pp under matched training. These results support evaluating centroid geometry and resistance to biased head retraining alongside WGA, within the tested protocols.
articles.bodyZh: 最差组准确率（WGA）用来评估一个已经训练好的预测器，但它没法说明当后面再接一个新头部（head）去训练时，那个被冻结的主干网络（backbone）会怎么表现。我们提出了 BiasFlow，这是一个基于钩子（hook）的工具包，用来监测类-属性质心对齐度（IBMI）、类内质心分离度（W-IBMI）以及特征投影敏感度。IBMI 会被类-属性相关性干扰，而且它并不是在衡量模型对因果特征的依赖。我们把这些诊断工具和 BiasFlow 正则化（BFR）配套使用，后者是一种有监督、可组合的类条件质心对齐惩罚项。W-IBMI 用来验证 BFR 优化的那个量；它依赖尺度，也不能单独证明属性已经被移除。在报告的小规模基准测试里，加入 BFR 能提升或保持平均 WGA，在 UrbanCars 上最多提升了 +26.0 个百分点。最主要的独立压力测试是冻结 CelebA-Std 的主干网络，并在有偏数据上训练全新的头部：BFR+GroupDRO 把 WGA 从 40.7% 提升到 64.1%，同时 Male 探针准确率从 92.5% 降到 72.2%。属性信息仍然可以恢复，跨任务结果则好坏参半。另一个受控的合成水印 ImageNet 实验，在匹配训练条件下还把水印偏移准确率提升了 +23.0 个百分点。这些结果支持在测试过的协议范围内，除了 WGA 之外，也评估质心几何结构以及对有偏头部再训练的抵抗能力。

articles.title: Learning to Read the Contextual Tokens in Diffusion Transformers
articles.zh: 学会读取Diffusion Transformer中的上下文化Token
articles.summary: 如果你在做DiT架构的可解释性或可控生成，这篇教你怎么把中间Token读出语义来
articles.author: Omer Dahary, Etai Sella 等
articles.body: Multimodal Diffusion Transformers (MM-DiTs) jointly process visual and textual representations throughout generation. These models repeatedly update the text tokens through multimodal attention, forming dynamic contextual tokens whose function is not well understood. In this work, we introduce a framework for reading this contextual space through natural-language interrogation. We train a lightweight bottleneck network that maps intermediate contextual tokens into the input space of a frozen Large Language Model (LLM), allowing the LLM to answer questions about the emerging image directly from these hidden representations. Our reader reveals that contextual tokens encode a rich, global representation of the emerging scene: generation-specific semantics, including attributes left underspecified by the prompt, are accessible surprisingly early in denoising, while increasingly fine-grained details become readable over time. Remarkably, this information remains decodable even when the MM-DiT receives an empty prompt, showing that contextual tokens accumulate substantial image-specific information from the evolving visual representation itself. We further find that generations with more readable contextual representations tend to receive higher human-preference scores. Building on these observations, we introduce Contextual Alignment, a training technique that explicitly reinforces the visual-semantic information encoded in the contextual tokens, improving generation quality and distributional coverage. Together, our results establish contextual tokens as both an interpretable view into the internal dynamics of MM-DiTs and an effective target for improving generative models.
articles.bodyZh: 多模态扩散 Transformer（Multimodal Diffusion Transformers，简称 MM-DiTs）在整个生成过程里，会同时处理视觉和文本这两类表示。这类模型会通过多模态注意力（multimodal attention）一遍遍更新文本词元（text tokens），慢慢形成一种动态的上下文词元（contextual tokens）；但这些词元到底在起什么作用，大家一直没太搞明白。在这项工作里，我们提出了一套框架，用自然语言提问（natural-language interrogation）的方式去“读懂”这个上下文空间。我们训练了一个轻量的瓶颈网络（bottleneck network），把中间层的上下文词元映射到一个冻结的大语言模型（Large Language Model，简称 LLM）的输入空间里，让这个 LLM 能直接根据这些隐藏表示，回答关于正在生成的图像的问题。我们的“读取器”发现，上下文词元其实编码了正在浮现的场景的一个丰富、全局的表示：跟当前生成有关的语义，包括提示词（prompt）没有明确说清楚的属性，在去噪（denoising）的非常早期就能被读到；而随着时间推移，越来越细的细节也会变得可读。更值得注意的是，就算 MM-DiT 收到的是空提示词，这些信息依然能被解码出来，说明上下文词元从不断演化的视觉表示本身，积累了大量和具体图像有关的信息。我们还进一步发现，那些上下文表示更容易被读懂的生成结果，往往也会拿到更高的人类偏好分数（human-preference scores）。基于这些观察，我们提出了上下文对齐（Contextual Alignment），这是一种训练技术，会明确强化上下文词元里编码的视觉语义信息，从而提升生成质量和分布覆盖（distributional coverage）。总的来说，我们的结果说明，上下文词元既能作为一个可解释的窗口，让我们看到 MM-DiT 的内部动态（internal dynamics），也能作为一个有效目标，用来改进生成模型（generative models）。

articles.title: Recursive Video In-Context Learning for Agentic Robot
articles.zh: 面向具身智能体的递归视频上下文学习
articles.summary: 如果你想让机器人看几段视频就学会新任务，这套递归式的视频上下文学习值得抄作业
articles.author: Wenrui Bao, Xinxin Liu 等
articles.body: LLM agents that orchestrate frozen vision-language-action (VLA) policies improve across episodes through text memory, which records what the agent did but not how the task is done. A demonstration video shows it, but fits poorly into an agent's context. The full video slows every turn, fixed keyframes lose the contact detail that decides whether a grasp holds, and what the agent needs shifts from the task's structure while planning to the frames around each contact. We introduce Recursive Video In-Context Learning (RV-ICL), a training-free method that turns a demonstration into a hierarchy the agent navigates rather than a prompt it receives. The hierarchy is built from the sub-events of the demonstration, such as grasps and releases. Its levels grow finer, from keyframes of the whole task to phases, moments and short clips, and are exposed through read-only tools. The agent reads the coarse levels before planning. During execution it re-enters the hierarchy whenever a step needs more detail and loads only the clip of its current sub-goal. One demonstration per task is enough. Built on RPent, RV-ICL raises success from 92.6% to 96.5% on LIBERO-PRO and from 86.7% to 95.8% on LIBERO-Plus.
articles.bodyZh: 那些负责编排冻结的视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略的大语言模型（LLM）智能体，能靠文本记忆（text memory）在一次次回合（episodes）里越做越好；但文本记忆只记下智能体做过什么，不会记下任务到底是怎么完成的。演示视频能展示这个过程，却很难塞进智能体的上下文（context）。完整视频会拖慢每一轮，固定关键帧（keyframes）又会丢掉决定抓取能不能抓牢的接触细节（contact detail），而且智能体需要的信息还会变：规划时更看重任务结构，到了每次接触前后，又更需要接触点周围的那些帧。于是我们提出递归视频上下文学习（Recursive Video In-Context Learning, RV-ICL），这是一种免训练（training-free）的方法，把演示变成一套智能体能自己导航的层级，而不是一份它被动接收的提示（prompt）。这个层级是根据演示里的子事件（sub-events）搭起来的，比如抓取和释放。它越往下越细，从整个任务的关键帧，到阶段、瞬间和短片段，并通过只读工具（read-only tools）开放给智能体。智能体在规划前先读粗粒度层级；执行过程中，只要某一步需要更多细节，它就会重新进入这个层级，并且只加载当前子目标对应的片段。每个任务只要一个演示就够了。基于 RPent，RV-ICL 把 LIBERO-PRO 上的成功率从 92.6% 提到 96.5%，把 LIBERO-Plus 上的成功率从 86.7% 提到 95.8%。

articles.title: UniSlider: Perceptually Uniform Sliders for Continuous Image Editing
articles.zh: UniSlider：面向连续图像编辑的感知均匀滑块
articles.summary: 如果你做图像编辑产品，用户拖滑块总觉得"前松后紧"，这个感知均匀的参数化能直接解决手感问题
articles.author: David Serrano-Lozano, Duygu Ceylan 等
articles.body: Sliders provide an intuitive interface for continuous image editing. In current generative approaches, however, the slider is simply a rescaling of the method's strength parameter, such as an adapter coefficient, a prompt weight, or an interpolation factor. This strength relates poorly to perceptual change. The image can partially revert as the slider moves, long stretches of the range produce no visible difference, and short intervals transform the image abruptly. Remapping the strength could fix this uneven pace, but only if the trajectory is monotone, which current methods do not enforce. We therefore distinguish the slider from the strength, and require perceptual distance from the input to grow linearly with the slider value. We introduce UniSlider, a lightweight LoRA trained on a few-step editing backbone so that its strength approximates this ideal slider. Few-step sampling lets us impose this objective in pixel space without intermediate ground truth, and the backbone's output is preserved at full strength. However, a low-rank adapter cannot make the strength fully uniform. Our slider is thus an inference-time remapping of the strength, obtained by adaptive sampling. Since training optmizes to make the trajectory monotone, this remapping closes the remaining gap without extra training or parameters. On a new benchmark of 300 continuous edits evaluating uniformity, monotonicity, edit fidelity, and identity preservation, UniSlider outperforms all prior methods and is preferred in a user study.
articles.bodyZh: 滑块（slider）为连续图像编辑提供了一种直观的操作界面。不过，在当前的生成方法中，滑块只不过是对方法强度参数（比如适配器系数、提示词权重或插值因子）的重新缩放。这种强度与感知变化之间的关系很差。图像可能会随着滑块移动而部分回退，很长一段范围没有任何可见变化，而短区间内图像又会突然剧变。重新映射强度或许能解决这种不均匀的节奏问题，但前提是轨迹必须是单调的，而当前方法并不保证这一点。因此，我们把滑块和强度区分开来，并要求图像与输入之间的感知距离随滑块值线性增长。我们提出了UniSlider，这是一个在少步编辑骨干上训练的轻量级LoRA，使其强度近似于这种理想滑块。少步采样让我们能够在像素空间中施加这一目标，而不需要中间真值，同时骨干的输出在全强度下仍被保留。然而，低秩适配器无法让强度完全均匀。因此，我们的滑块是在推理时通过自适应采样对强度进行重新映射。由于训练优化的是让轨迹单调，这种重新映射无需额外训练或参数就能弥合剩余差距。在一个包含300个连续编辑、评估均匀性、单调性、编辑保真度和身份保持的新基准上，UniSlider优于所有先前方法，并在用户研究中更受青睐。

articles.title: MemPilot: Orchestrating On-Demand Multimodal Memory Curation for LLM Agents
articles.zh: MemPilot：为LLM Agent编排按需触发的多模态记忆管理
articles.summary: 如果你在搭长周期Agent但记忆又乱又贵，这篇的按需多模态记忆编排思路能省成本还提效果
articles.author: Haozhen Zhang, Haodong Yue 等
articles.body: Memory has become integral to the LLM agent ecosystem, supporting information retention and reuse across interactions. However, most existing agent memory systems construct memory in a query-agnostic manner, which can incur unnecessary preprocessing cost and discard details that later prove essential. Recent studies have begun shifting memory processing toward runtime adaptation, but typically specialize in particular operations or fixed processing schemes, leaving flexible control over performance, cost, and latency largely underexplored. To address this challenge, we present \textbf{MemPilot}, a flexible framework that orchestrates on-demand memory curation under different performance--cost--latency preferences. Specifically, we optimize a multi-step LLM policy via reinforcement learning to iteratively choose between retrieving from query-agnostic memory and delegating query-specific curation of raw multimodal history to heterogeneous LLMs and VLMs. The policy jointly controls evidence amount, curation instructions, model selection, and visual access, enabling fine-grained allocation of runtime computation. To optimize this policy under competing objectives, we adapt objective-wise advantage decoupling by separately estimating each objective's advantage before aggregation. Moreover, we introduce prefix-based marginal utility estimation for fine-grained credit assignment across multi-step rollouts. Experiments on five multimodal agent-memory benchmarks demonstrate favorable performance--cost--latency trade-offs across optimization preferences, with preference sweeps yielding broader frontiers than existing trade-off-aware baselines.
articles.bodyZh: 记忆现在已经成了大语言模型（LLM）智能体（agent）生态里必不可少的一部分，它能让信息在多次交互中保留下来、反复使用。但问题是，现在大多数智能体记忆系统在建记忆的时候，根本不管用户接下来会问什么，也就是“跟查询无关”。这么干不仅会带来没必要的预处理开销，还可能把后面真正有用的细节给丢掉。最近有些研究开始把记忆处理往“运行时动态适配”的方向转，但通常只针对某些特定操作，或者用固定的处理流程，对于性能、成本、延迟这三者到底怎么灵活控制，其实还没怎么深入探索。为了解决这个难题，我们提出了 MemPilot，一个灵活的框架，可以根据不同的性能—成本—延迟偏好，按需来打理记忆。具体来说，我们通过强化学习（reinforcement learning）去优化一个多步的 LLM 策略，让它在每一步迭代时自己选：是从那些跟查询无关的记忆里检索，还是把针对具体查询的原始多模态（multimodal）历史记录，交给不同的 LLM 和视觉语言模型（VLM）去整理。这个策略会同时控制证据用多少、整理指令怎么下、选哪个模型、以及要不要看视觉信息，从而在运行时对计算资源做细粒度的分配。为了在多个相互竞争的目标下优化这个策略，我们采用了按目标拆分优势（advantage）的方法，先把每个目标的优势分别估出来，再合并。另外，我们还引入了基于前缀的边际效用（marginal utility）估计，这样在多步推演（rollouts）过程中，就能把每一步的贡献（credit assignment）算得更细。我们在五个多模态智能体记忆基准上做了实验，结果证明，面对不同的优化偏好，MemPilot 都能在性能、成本、延迟之间取得不错的平衡；而且通过扫描不同偏好，它得到的边界比那些已有的权衡感知基线（baseline）方法更宽。

articles.title: CLIFT: Conformal Self-Verification for Web Agent Training and Test-Time Scaling
articles.zh: CLIFT：面向Web Agent训练与测试时扩展的共形自验证
articles.summary: 如果你在训Web Agent，老是缺可靠的成功信号来筛数据，这套共形自验证能同时用在训练和推理扩展上
articles.author: Yifan Zhang, Yutong Dai 等
articles.body: Open-source web agents are now strong enough to execute realistic browser tasks, but training them with reinforcement learning still depends on weak supervision: binary task success is too sparse for credit assignment, while frontier-language-model judges are too expensive to call at every step and cannot be assumed available at deployment. We introduce CLIFT, a training and test-time scaling method built around conformal self-verification. During training, the agent answers natural-language verification questions about its own rollouts; a Compositional Conformal Certifier keeps only question signals whose URL-conditional evidence agrees with a training-time judge, assigns signed trust weights through polarity-aware lift, and blends the resulting verifier score into per-step rewards in a way that never subtracts from the judge baseline. At test time, the same certified bank is frozen and reused as structured evidence for Conformal Trajectory Selection (CTS): the agent samples a greedy rollout and one or more diverse retries, the self-verifier summarises each URL trace, and a conservative majority-vote rule chooses whether to swap away from the current incumbent without calling any external judge. This single mechanism supports three settings. On WebArena Infinity, CLIFT achieves state-of-the-art performance among open-source web agents. On VisualWebArena, a bank trained with the open model transfers to GPT-5.5 at test time and reaches state-of-the-art performance under the canonical harness. On Online Mind2Web, without training an agent on the benchmark, translating the certified question bank improves a live-web agent in zero-shot evaluation. Together these results position conformal self-verification as a way to turn costly judge feedback into a reusable training signal and a judge-free test-time scaling signal.
articles.bodyZh: 现在，开源网页智能体（web agent）已经强到能执行真实浏览器任务了，但用强化学习（reinforcement learning）来训练它们，还是得靠很弱的监督信号：只拿二元任务成功（binary task success）当反馈太稀疏，根本没法做好信用分配（credit assignment）；而让前沿语言模型裁判（frontier-language-model judge）来打分又太贵，没法每一步都调用，也不能假设部署（deployment）的时候一定用得上。我们提出 CLIFT，一种围绕共形自验证（conformal self-verification）搭起来的训练和测试时扩展（test-time scaling）方法。训练时，智能体会回答关于自己 rollout（轨迹采样）的自然语言验证问题；一个组合式共形认证器（Compositional Conformal Certifier）只保留那些在 URL 条件证据（URL-conditional evidence）上跟训练时裁判（training-time judge）判断一致的问题信号，通过极性感知提升（polarity-aware lift）给它们分配带正负号的信任权重（signed trust weights），再把算出来的验证器分数（verifier score）融进每一步奖励（per-step rewards）里，而且这种融合只会往上加，绝不会从裁判基线（judge baseline）里扣。到了测试时，同一个认证题库（certified bank）会被冻住、反复拿来用，当成共形轨迹选择（Conformal Trajectory Selection, CTS）的结构化证据：智能体会先采一个贪心 rollout（greedy rollout），再采一个或多个不一样的重新尝试（diverse retries），自验证器（self-verifier）会总结每条 URL 轨迹（URL trace），再用一个保守的多数投票规则（conservative majority-vote rule）决定要不要把当前占着位置的轨迹（incumbent）换掉，全程不用叫任何外部裁判（external judge）。就靠这一套机制，能支持三种场景。在 WebArena Infinity 上，CLIFT 在开源网页智能体里做到了最先进（state-of-the-art）的水平。在 VisualWebArena 上，用开源模型训练出来的题库，到了测试时能迁移到 GPT-5.5，并且在标准评测框架（canonical harness）下也达到了最先进水平。在 Online Mind2Web 上，哪怕没在这个基准（benchmark）上训练智能体，只是把认证题库转译/迁移过去，也能让一个实时网页智能体（live-web agent）在零样本评测（zero-shot evaluation）里表现更好。这些结果放一起看，说明共形自验证（conformal self-verification）可以是一条路子：把昂贵的裁判反馈变成能重复用的训练信号，也变成一种不需要裁判的测试时扩展信号（test-time scaling signal）。
